scope: Preview origins for human sprites and the reviewed DoubleTripod rig/coat only. No PNG reencoding, simulation, world-scale, collider or combat-draw changes.
cause: Fitted previews placed the historical frame pivot at the cell centre. That pivot could represent the feet or sprite layout rather than the lower torso/chassis, so independently drawn costumes and facings shifted horizontally despite stable height.
change: A distinct preview body datum determines the horizontal drawing origin. Reviewed per-frame previewDatumX is preferred; otherwise a decoded alpha lower-body-band median estimates the body axis. Coat chassis axes are pinned to exact source SHA+rect. The articulated original rig receives its own alpha body datum from its native ready render.

bodyDatumAPI.appliesTo: first idle of each authored facing, reviewed independently

previewGeometryFields.bodyX: target body axis at cell centre
previewGeometryFields.datum: source coordinate, pivot, method, PNG pin and rectangle

mechanicalAxisReview.axis: lower chassis between hip joints; forward upper sphere, fedora, forearms and coat outline excluded

TLSVerification.finalMode: proxy SPKI scoped trust, otherwise normal TLS authority checks

preservedAttempts.HORIZONTAL_BODY_DATUM_ACTUAL_V1.json: Overly strict projection tolerance1e-6 rejected Canvas transform float rounding of about4e-6 pixels; all28 draws were genuine and had no clipping. Final tolerance1e-4 is substantially below1 pixel.
preservedAttempts.LAZY_HORIZONTAL_BODY_DATUM_ACTUAL_V1.jso: Initial restricted Chrome profile failed public-source authority validation; temporary broad browser trust was used for diagnosis only. Final fresh browser used only explicit proxy SPKI trust and all16 draws passed.

limits: The alpha median is a silhouette estimate, not a certified anatomical landmark. Unusual bodies and equipment crossing the band should provide reviewed previewDatumX.
A stable body axis does not make the full silhouette, head or accessory bounding box identical across independent poses.
Original articulated-rig source coordinates come from previewMeasure; the original sprite previewGeometry explicitly names its coat stature reference.
Existing art and canonical-fidelity qualifications remain unchanged.
No Git commit, production deployment, other module, HTML or source image was changed by this agent.
